title: Hourly range-expansion bar closing at its high, continuation hold in uptrend

source.title: Opening range breakout (ORB) trading strategy - Altrady

rule_summary: Closed 1h candles, UTC. Range(t)=high-low of bar t; ATR(t)=mean true range of the 24 bars before t. Pos(t)=(close-low)/(high-low). ENTRY at close of bar t when ALL hold: Range(t) >= 3.0*ATR(t); Pos(t) >= 0.8; close(t) > open(t); close(t) > SMA(480) of 1h closes; no open position. Buy at next bar open. EXIT at the first of: a bar close below the low of the entry-signal bar (stop, executed next open); or 24 bars after entry (time exit at that bar's open). No re-entry for 6 bars after an exit. No pyramiding, no take-profit.
mechanism: The source only suggests taking breakouts whose candle is large versus recent candles and closes near its extreme; it gives no mechanism. Closest honest one: an abnormally large bar closing at its high marks forced or stop-driven buying (short covering, breakout stops) that clears liquidity; slower participants and algos chase over the following hours, so drift continues. A 3x-ATR shock bar makes a mean gross move above 0.35% plausible.
